newsitem.title: USA: National Medical names president, CEO.
newsitem.headline: National Medical names president, CEO.

text.p: National Medical Financial Services Corp said Thursday that effective February 1 Alan Carr-Locke resigned as president, chief executive and director to pursue other business ventures.
Effective March 14, the company said it appointed Douglas Colkitt, chairman and principal stockholder, to serve as the president and chief executive.
Colkitt also serves as the chairman, chief executive and director of EquiMed Inc.
